title: data set: state schema — .vsdd/state.yaml contents enumeration with published marker
description: Round 2 of #598. The Deterministic phase answer contract's contents enumeration as versioned data: current phase, current layer, open-findings pointer, last gate result, active composition, and the published marker (the machine-readable publish-state the fix-lane falsifiers consult). Ships as the pair: registry artifact + mdatron schema. Consistency constraints declared (state claiming phase 2b requires a recorded red-gate result; published immutable once present); execution is mdatron's state-consistency family (Layer 7) with vsdd bootstrap self-validation until it lands (the phase-state resolution). Operator walk-through items: initial-state representation, open-findings-pointer shape, whether active_composition records its input hash. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: solution-architect.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: OPERATOR RULINGS 2026-07-20, all three open notes resolved: (1) pre-entry representation — nullable with pinned semantics: current_phase null means 'not yet entered', current_layer null means 'decomposition not yet authored', the derivation maps each to its enter action; no pseudo-phase token, reserved-word rule intact. (2) open_findings_pointer — {milestone: <exact name>}: the active layer's milestone, open findings are its open children, one crosslink query. (3) active_composition gains config_inputs_hash over the DESIGN.md surfaces + review config, making stale compositions mechanically detectable. Draft revised in place; lands with round 2 once the #666 vocabulary walk concludes.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Resolved: the set landed with round 2 — registry artifact + mdatron schema pair, operator rulings applied (see the decision trail above). Evidence: the round-2 commit (mdatron verify clean after catching and fixing a real YAML defect in the first attempt — E0050, flow-map comma split, the pair rule's first live catch on its own package).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: RULING AMENDED by operator (2026-07-22, the Layer 2 oracle review): the null current_phase mapping changes from THE ENTER ACTION to THE FIRST PHASE'S AUTHORING ACTION — 1a-author-behavioral-spec. Rationale, operator's words: name the work, not the ceremony — a fresh project's first answer should say what to do, not that a transition exists. The null-is-pinned meaning (not yet entered) stands unchanged; only the derivation's mapping moves. enter-next-phase remains a registered member for post-exit transitions. Applied to: state-schema.md semantics, the pre-entry convergence fixture's reference answer, and the derivation's draft rule table (vsdd-cli #738 trail).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: AMENDMENT CONSEQUENCE, recorded (2026-07-22, operator's error-state question): removing the ceremony removed the act that wrote the entry. Under the work-not-ceremony mapping, THE FIRST WORK COMMIT CARRIES THE ENTRY — the state advances to phase-1a in the same commit as the first authoring artifact, the boundary-evidence rule applied at entry, so no phase is ever unoccupied and the were-phase answer holds through 1a. Semantics sentence lands data-side with this record.
